knowledge.text: The added search-phase and desklamp guidance produced no observable step or outcome change when the target object was found at the first location the Actor visited in a current task: in train:0000 (look at alarmclock under the desklamp), train:0001 (examine the cd with the desklamp), train:0003 (look at pillow under the desklamp), train:0008 (put a soapbar in garbagecan) and train:0009 (put some statue on coffeetable), Parent and Candidate ran identical step sequences and both succeeded (5/5, 4/4, 4/4, 4/4 and 4/4 steps). Under these easy conditions the edit neither harmed nor helped; taking the required object as soon as it was observed, delivering it straight to the target receptacle, and immediately using a desklamp present at the current location were all preserved.

knowledge.text: Two Parent step-limit failures became short Candidate successes when the goal object lay on an open surface the Parent's sweep never reached. train:0021 (put a cool bread in countertop): the Parent spent all 50 steps cycling cabinets 1-3, the fridge, countertops 1-2, shelf 1 and drawers 1-2 (P2:1 cabinet 1, P2:7 countertop 1, P2:14 countertop 2, P2:16 shelf 1, P2:35 drawer 1, final step P2:50) and never arrived at countertop 3, where bread 1 lay; the Candidate went countertop 1 → countertop 2 → countertop 3 (Q2:1-Q2:3), took bread 1 at Q2:4 and finished in 8. train:0023 (put a cool bread in countertop): the Parent cycled countertop 1/2, the fridge, cabinets 1-4 and drawer 1 (P4:1, P4:2, P4:3, P4:5, P4:30, P4:39, final step P4:50) and never visited diningtable 1, which held breads 1-4; the Candidate reached diningtable 1 at Q4:3, took bread 1 at Q4:4 and finished in 8. A milder version appears in train:0020 (clean some spoon and put it in diningtable), where the Parent went countertop 1 (nothing), then opened drawer 1 (empty) and drawer 2 (spatula 1, spoon 1) before taking spoon 1 at P1:6 for 10 steps, while the Candidate went countertop 1 then the uninspected countertop 2, took spoon 2 at Q1:3, cleaned it and delivered in 7 steps; both succeeded.
